span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the first images are made by four teams working independently and without interaction, in the authors' words to minimize shared bias - and each team nonetheless recovered a ring of similar diameter brightened to the south
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: a parameter combination is admitted to the Top-Set only if it both fits the observed data AND reconstructs four known geometries - ring, crescent, filled disk, asymmetric double - from synthetic data, so the imaging parameters are validated against ground truth and not only against the object under study
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: because the reconstructed resolutions differ between pipelines, each image is blurred with a circular Gaussian to one common and deliberately conservative resolution before use
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: systematic baseline error is measured rather than assumed: three independent fringe-fitting pipelines, two polarizations and two frequency bands are compared against each other, and the residual disagreement between them IS the quoted systematic
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the two frequency bands are correlated on two separate software correlators at two institutions, and a few identical scans are passed through both so that any difference between the correlators would show up as a disagreement on the same input
span.note: about this quote: Q-608, 2026-08-16: THE STAGED TEXT SCRAMBLES A NAME INSIDE THIS QUOTE. It reads "at the MIT Haystack Observatory and at fur Radioastronomie" - the words "the Max-Planck-Institut" were displaced by the extraction and appear roughly 400 characters later, mid-sentence, in "At correlation, signals were aligned ... the Max-Planck-Institut". The two institutions are MIT Haystack and the Max-Planck-Institut fur Radioastronomie. The quote is an exact substring of the staged file and the file is wrong here, not the tag. NOT a furniture crossing - the extraction reordered words WITHIN a sentence, which no guard in TOOLS/ can see, because the result is contiguous, unique and verbatim.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: one highly sensitive station is used as the array's reference station, which is what enabled the ionospheric and tropospheric corrections at the other sites
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the absolute flux scale is refined using the array's own redundancy - pairs of telescopes that sit at the same site and therefore see the same baseline - rather than resting on each telescope's independently estimated sensitivity
span.note: about this quote: Q-608, 2026-08-16: THE STAGED TEXT SCRAMBLES A CITATION INSIDE THIS QUOTE. It reads "utilizing array redundancy via III), we refined the absolute network calibration (Paper amplitude calibration of telescopes" - the parenthetical "(Paper III)" has been split and its halves interleaved with the surrounding clause. Read as: "utilizing array redundancy via network calibration (Paper III), we refined the absolute amplitude calibration of telescopes that are colocated...". Verbatim of the file, and the file is wrong. Same class as [4]: a within-sentence reordering, invisible to every guard.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the simulated images are put through the same VLBI simulation, the same observing schedule and weather, the same calibration and the same imaging pipeline as the real data, so that model and observation are compared after identical processing rather than before it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The interferometric sampling is sparse, so image reconstruction is an under-constrained inverse problem requiring extra assumptions.
span.note: what this limits: every reconstructed image: BECAUSE THE (u, v) PLANE IS ONLY SPARSELY SAMPLED, THE INVERSE PROBLEM IS UNDER-CONSTRAINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Visibility data lack absolute phase calibration and carry potentially large amplitude calibration uncertainties.
span.note: what this limits: the visibility data underlying it: THE MEASURED VISIBILITIES LACK ABSOLUTE PHASE CALIBRATION AND CAN HAVE LARGE AMPLITUDE CALIBRATION UNCERTAINTIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The geometric crescent fits measure the size of the emitting region, not the size of the shadow itself, and may be biased.
span.note: what this limits: every diameter quoted from the crescent fits: THEY MEASURE Quotation withheld
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Physically very different theoretical models fit the data equally well, so a good fit does not select a preferred model.
span.note: what this limits: any inference from goodness of fit to physics: ALTHOUGH THE FIT TO THE OBSERVATIONS IS EQUALLY GOOD IN THE THREE CASES, THEY REFER TO RADICALLY DIFFERENT PHYSICAL SCENARIOS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The illustrative thin-ring model used to interpret the visibility amplitudes does not account for all features of the data.
span.note: what this limits: the illustrative thin-ring model: IT IS ONLY ILLUSTRATIVE AND DOES NOT FIT ALL FEATURES IN THE DATA
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The headline mass is an average across three different modelling methods, not a single measurement.
span.note: what this limits: the mass value as one measurement: it is the average of geometric models, GRMHD models and image domain ring extraction
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The ring diameter depends on which extraction method is used, and the paper gives a range for that reason.
span.note: what this limits: a single ring-diameter value: the paper states the value depends on the extraction method and gives a range accordingly
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The observed ring diameter tracks the mass only up to several other factors, including instrument resolution and the structure of the emitting region.
span.note: what this limits: converting the observed diameter directly to a mass: it also depends on observing resolution, spin vector, inclination, and the size and structure of the emitting region
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only some exotic alternatives to a black hole are excluded, and the exclusion depends on an assumed maximum-mass prior.
span.note: what this limits: the result as excluding alternatives to black holes generally: only some exotic compact objects are excluded, and that rests on the maximum mass prior
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The distance to M87 is adopted from other work rather than measured here, and it enters the mass.
span.note: what this limits: the mass as independent of external inputs: the distance is adopted from three stellar population measurements reported elsewhere
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: three independent imaging pipelines run on the same data, cross-compared against each other and against the two polarizations and the two frequency bands
span.note: eliminates: an artefact of one reduction chain - a ring produced by the algorithm rather than present in the sky. Three teams that never shared a pipeline have to agree before the image stands
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a Top-Set of imaging parameter combinations kept only if they BOTH fitted the observed data AND recovered accurate images from synthetic data with a known answer
span.note: eliminates: parameters tuned until the expected picture appears - the synthetic data has a ground truth, so a setting that flatters the real data but fails the known case is discarded
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
